run_homography_pipeline: run the homography computation pipeline on a directory of images using LoFTR matching and RANSAC
find_homography_between_images: find the 3x3 homography matrix between two BGR images using LoFTR keypoints and RANSAC
find_matches_loftr: find matched keypoints and confidence scores between two images using the LoFTR neural matcher
init_matches_loftr: initialize a LoFTR match finder with a pretrained outdoor or indoor model on a given device
compute_homographies_for_image_sequence: compute pairwise homographies for a sorted sequence of images and save results as numpy arrays
